tests.T1: Chat capability — what the agent can do inside chat answers
tests.T2: Service usage — services the agent can discover and call out to
tests.T4: Process management — pipeline, concurrency, quota recovery
tests.T5: Tool management — per-tool rules shared across agents
tests.T6: Session continuity — sessions, context, crash-safe resume

classValues.adapter: works via a per-class adapter (see notes)

capabilities.prove: live smoke: matrix PNG delivered; user-asked tables arrive aligned, never raw pipes; JSON pipeline builds on VPS

Delivery guarantee (auto-align to <pre>) lives in chunkForTelegram/sendCopyable: covers bot-host family + collab router. Grok TG router sends plain text (no parse_mode), so its path is the MEDIA: pipeline, not pre-blocks; Hermes gateway is a separate stack.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: bug dispatch lands in orchestrator queue
capabilities.notes: Bug → orchestrator so the agent doesn't fix it itself. status/stop/cancel/list-models per bug (V-29). Box lanes have their own dispatch.

capabilities.notes: Model A self-serves via shared skill (contact model A); never message @Meal_audit_bot from coding bots.

Grok TG router imports the vendored mirror; the checker fails on any drift, so a format change lands everywhere via one edit + sync. Box redeploy (sync-from-repo + deploy-to-live) still needed to activate router-side. Collab sends single thinking notes; Hermes gateway is a separate stack.

capabilities.prove: unit test: provider stderr classified in ~10s, small=true ignored
capabilities.notes: extractLogError/humanizeRunError + --print-logs fail-fast. small=true title-agent errors never fatal. Router mirrors the vocabulary.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: second agent routes around claimed files, never refuses
capabilities.notes: Per-file advisory claims replace the old global dispatch lock. Chat never gated; same-file overlap warns, never blocks.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: status/stop/list-models on a live bug id
capabilities.notes: V-29 ops: per-bug records, action-aware heartbeats, 3m stagnation breaker. Single-runtime by design.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: killed service restarts; one poller per token enforced
capabilities.notes: systemd restart + registry one-poller guard (BOT-5). Phone uses its own restart loop; Colab uses the GPU-only watchdog.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: /models + /freemodel list; mid-chat /model switch works
capabilities.notes: Learnings land in the picker/catalog once; all agents inherit. `/freemodel` is location-scoped: each host lists only locally installed/authenticated tools, provider catalog entries, and its own quota. Cline Free deepseek is wallet-independent of OpenCode. Gemini is exposed through OpenCode, not as a standalone picker surface.

capabilities.prove: unit behaviour: thinking variants + compressed reasoning traces

capabilities.notes: Learning loop: opencode failures auto-record (lane/kind/hint, best-effort, BOT_FAILURE_LOG=0 disables); review-failures.mjs groups by signature — 2nd occurrence without a linked sensor/learning must produce one (ratchet). Grok TG keeps its ticket reports; Hermes stack separate.
